\begin{lemma}\label{lem:hard}
The crux estimate holds uniformly.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:easy}
The easy bound holds.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Cauchy--Schwarz.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:goal}
The main bound follows.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Combine \ref{lem:hard} with \ref{lem:easy}.
\end{proof}
